title: Fall back when CI does not cover the base

rubric.text: Does not treat green CI on B8 or another repository as proof for B9 because the evidence must be on the exact base SHA.
Runs the needed baseline checks locally before asserting the baseline is green.
Keeps local baseline work to what the plan needs rather than inventing extra checks.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
